newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion plans to buy another China brewery.
newsitem.headline: Lion plans to buy another China brewery.

text.p: Chief executive of Lion Nathan Ltd, Douglas Myers, said on Thursday that the Australasian brewer envisaged buying another brewery in China of a similar size to its Wuxi plant within 12-18 months.

"We continue to review opportunities for new investment in other existing breweries within the Yangtse delta region, consistent with our strategy of achieving a critical mass of volume within a prosperous area," he told a news conference.
Myers said the company had cooled assumptions on its plans for India and was "more engrossed" with China.
Earlier, Lion reported a net profit of NZ$150.4 million for the year to August 31.

In China, Wuxi Brewery operating earnings of $2.3 million, up from $1.2 million, contributed to an overall $0.2 million loss from China Brewing operations after corporate and market development costs. This compared with a $3.4 million prior year loss. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
